summary: Iteration 17 — origin outage resilience verified end-to-end (backend 11/11, frontend 8/8). BACKEND: GET /health -> 200 in ~0.33s; GET /api/health -> 200 in ~0.13s (both < 1.5s, no dep on background jobs); GET /api/dvf/status -> state='idle', total=110213, progress=1.0 (no auto-ingest since data exists); seed login OK, wrong password -> 401 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect'; /auth/me 200 with seed token, 401 without; /api/properties list OK; property 6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758 detail OK with estimation.value populated. (2) route('**/api/auth/me' -> 520) + reload -> testID startup-error visible with text 'Serveur momentanément indisponibleLe serveur est momentanément indisponible (erreur 520). Réessayez dans un instant.', welcome-screen NOT shown, token PRESERVED in localStorage. (3) unroute + tap startup-retry -> home-screen visible (still signed in, no re-login). (4) route('**/api/properties' -> 503 body '{}') -> home-error-detail contains 'Le serveur est momentanément indisponible (erreur 503)…'; unroute + home-retry-button -> property list loads. (6) route('**/api/auth/me' -> 401 {"detail":"Session invalide"}) + reload -> welcome-screen shown AND localStorage token removed. (7) Regression: sign in wrong password -> signin-screen-error 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect'. (8) Regression: /property/6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758 -> estimation-value 'Valeur centrale 196 000 €'. Seed account NOT modified. Never called POST /api/dvf/ingest. Pre-existing shadow* deprecation warning still emitted (non-blocking, unchanged from iter 16).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/jobs.py: heavy pipeline runs in a spawned multiprocessing.Process (daemon=True), niced to 10 after configurable delay. Fresh boot delays DVF ingest+train by 45s (default) so /health and /api/health answer fast during warmup — matches the 520 mitigation.

/app/backend/server.py:191 POST /api/dvf/ingest passes 0.0 as the delay to jobs.ingest_then_train, so the manual trigger is immediate while the boot-time trigger at server.py:931 uses the 45s default. Confirms user request: 'do NOT call POST /api/dvf/ingest' (has no delay).
/app/backend/dvf_ingest.py download() streams the .csv.gz to a `.part` temp file then atomic-renames — avoids partial files being served as complete after a crash.

/app/frontend/src/auth.tsx: token is NO LONGER wiped on network/5xx errors during startup (only on 401 via typed ApiError.status). On non-401 errors, setStartupError is set and the retry button forces a re-run via `setAttempt`. Verified visually: 520 -> startup-error, 401 -> signOut.

/app/frontend/src/api.ts: ApiError carries status; 5xx maps to 'Le serveur est momentanément indisponible (erreur <code>)…', network failure maps to 'Serveur injoignable…' with status=0. The onUnauthorized handler is only invoked when status===401 AND a token is set AND the path is not /auth/*, which correctly avoids signing out during login/register failures.

/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx: renders <View testID="startup-error"> with Text 'Serveur momentanément indisponible' + startupError detail + <Pressable testID="startup-retry">Réessayer</Pressable> when startupError && !user. Matches expected testIDs.
seed_data_creation: None. Seed account delivered@resend.dev used read-only for login. No throwaway account created. Never called POST /api/dvf/ingest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resilience mitigation for the Cloudflare 520 ('Dans Expo Go erreur 520') is fully working on web preview. Startup 5xx/network hiccups keep the token and surface testID=startup-error + startup-retry; only real 401 signs the user out. In-app network/5xx after login surface home-error-detail with the same friendly copy + home-retry-button. Backend defers heavy jobs by 45s after boot (jobs.ingest_then_train) so the pod passes health probes on cold start; POST /api/dvf/ingest triggers immediately (delay 0.0) — do NOT call it during regression as it will re-import DVF. The user's original bug (Expo Go 520 on live) cannot be reproduced on the preview and was simulated with Playwright page.route(...). Test file to reuse: /app/backend/tests/test_resilience_iter17.py.
rca_of_issue: USER BUG 'Dans Expo Go erreur 520' = Cloudflare 520 (origin unavailable). RCA: at cold boot on the deployed pod, /health / /api/health responses were competing with a synchronous DVF import + hedonic/ml training in the same process; the pod got OOM/CPU-starved before Cloudflare could reach the origin. MITIGATION shipped this iteration: heavy jobs moved to a spawned multiprocessing.Process (jobs.py), delayed 45s after boot and niced to 10 (server.py:931) so /health/api/health respond fast; DVF download switched to streamed `.part` temp file (dvf_ingest.py). FRONTEND RESILIENCE: ApiError carries HTTP status; stored session is NO LONGER wiped on network/5xx at startup (auth.tsx:74-80, only 401 wipes the token). A dedicated 'Serveur momentanément indisponible' screen with testID=startup-error / startup-retry is rendered instead of falling back to welcome (_layout.tsx:31-46). In-app queries display home-error-detail + home-retry-button with the same friendly copy (index.tsx:83-90). All 8 outage-simulation flows verified via Playwright route interception.
